env BOLERO_MODULE=off
[short] skip

# 'bolero install' with no arguments should clean up after bolero build
cd mycmd
bolero build
exists mycmd$GOEXE
bolero install
! exists mycmd$GOEXE

# 'bolero install mycmd' does not clean up, even in the mycmd directory
bolero build
exists mycmd$GOEXE
bolero install mycmd
exists mycmd$GOEXE

# 'bolero install mycmd' should not clean up in an unrelated current directory either
cd ..
cp mycmd/mycmd$GOEXE mycmd$GOEXE
bolero install mycmd
exists mycmd$GOEXE

-- mycmd/main.go --
package main
func main() {}
